integrity: Analytic proof and reproducible numerical check supplied; computations do not imply independent validation. No claims of independent audit or priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive aspect ratio and fixed dimension at least three; invariant-line sampling, not point-based chords. Joint law requires off-rim endpoint patches. Earlier complete univariate cylinder length law (Kellerer 1971, Mäder 1980) fully acknowledged; 1980 paper full-text inaccessible, so residual historical-priority risk. Exact first-public day for 1971/1980 papers unverified; the metadata date corresponds only to verified original arXiv:0711.4734v1 (2007-11-29), not earliest cylinder-work chronology.
title: Joint endpoint and deficit laws for near-diameter chords of round cylinders
